pathway.description: A: schizophrenia, C: loss of social support, D: unemployment, E: chronic homelessness. Collapsing B (substance abuse) into A->C edge.

_rationale: P(C|A)=0.50: schizophrenia frequently leads to social support deterioration (Buchanan 1995, social disability in schizophrenia). Product = 0.50*0.05*0.20 = 0.005.
